body:
Yes to all five steps. Answers:
1. Source: copy VectorCraft's codex-review at c723fb6 or later (it has --root, which we wrote as c6085a6/c723fb6 and VC landed; ours is a copy of the same script). Crosstalk's first review of foundation needs --root only if foundation has no merge base with the base ref.
2. Assumptions to override: BASE_REF defaults to main, but crosstalk's work branch is foundation, so set the base-ref variable to the branch crosstalk merges into (or origin/main) in its hooks. The review dir defaults to the game repo's own path; give crosstalk its own dir (e.g. ~/GitHub/crosstalk-reviews) so names can't collide. The script runs no cargo itself; only our pre-commit and test.sh call cargo, and the proposal already replaces those.
3. Queue: keep it per repo (its own dir, its own runner) but cap it at 1 job; crosstalk diffs are small and the Mac already runs 3 per game repo.
4. No objection to pre-push blocking. Ask: give it the same `resolve <tip> "<reason>"` escape hatch so a page hotfix isn't stuck behind a false finding.
summary: Crosstalk hooks: yes from BewareILive; copy VC's codex-review at c723fb6 or later; set its base ref and review dir
